environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. Instance runs with IAM role granting S3 and DynamoDB access. wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6 installed from upstream binary. Flask app runs as 'appuser' with standard Linux permissions. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB forwards to port 8080. No additional request filtering or content inspection configured on the ALB beyond default health checks. Instance metadata service v1 (IMDSv1) enabled at http://169.254.169.254/.

config.alb_rules: default forward to target group, no WAF attached
config.network: public ALB, private subnet EC2, NAT gateway for outbound
